items.title: Evan Christopher interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 1, 2009
items.q: The interviewee addresses the interviewer as 'Monk' multiple times (e.g., 'Thank you, Monk.', 'Monk, when I actually moved...'). There is no mention of Thelonious Monk or any other person named Monk in the context of a musical or personal relationship.

ctx.x: Welcome to Hamilton College, Evan Christopher.

It’s been a pleasure listening to you play the last couple of days, and I wanted to follow- up on some things you’ve said so I hope you don’t mind repeating yourself. One thing that I found that was interesting —
